lines.en: What I can do, though, is finally talk to Osako about her cool new haircut.
: And now it’s time for the main event.
: You leaving and me preparing for my next class?
: You don’t have another class. It’s all in your head.
: There are a lot of things in my head right now, but I can assure you that my schedule is not one of-
: Wha-
: I’m sorry. I’ve been just overcome by an immense need to ruffle your hair up.
: Right. But, just to remind you, I probably could have been an Olympian if I applied myself. So you invading my personal space is-
: Your hair is so soft now.
: What do you mean “now?!” I’ve never let you touch me before! And I’m not about to start just because of your “immense needs!”
: Sorry. I’ve gotten it out of my system. I’m just not used to you looking so cute.
: Yeah, well...it was just time for a change. But not the kind of change that makes it okay for you to lay your gross fingers all over me.
: They’re not gross.
: How many girls have they been inside now?
: Not enough. Also, you like girls.
: Yeah, but the ones I like are a little older. So if you do that again, I’m just going to break your entire arm off.
: Fair enough. But I would now like to press you about why you felt the need for a “change” as it coincides with a thing that’s been on my mind a lot lately.
: Don’t you have better things to do with your time than worrying about a pair of local lesbians?
: There’s saving the world, but that’s just really hard.
: You’re seriously still worried about us?
: Yes. And even more so now that you’ve changed your hairstyle. That’s a breakup move.
: It’s not always a breakup move, you know. Sometimes, a girl just...wants to change up her look.
: Is that what’s happening this time?
: Kind of, yeah.
: So you two are still together?
: Kind of, yeah.
: Being “kind of” together doesn’t really bode well for the future, Osako.
: Yeah, you think I don’t fucking know that?
: Sometimes, it feels like the only reason we’re still together at all is because it would be too inconvenient to break up.
: But dwelling on it any longer isn’t going to do me any good. So I figured- hey. What signifies a fresh start better than a...fresh hairstyle?
: We could always have another foursome. That seemed to work pretty well at reigniting your chemistry last time.
: Almost too well. But I’m going to throw myself into blissful ignorance and just assume that was a coincidence.
: So are you two just...on a break now or something?
: No...it’s not like that.
: We’re still together. We’re still living in the same house and sleeping in the same bed, but...there are some things that have to change if we’re going to get back to the way we were.
: And, as you may have guessed, they’re mostly on my end. So I’m just trying to...focus on myself for now. Put myself in a better head-space.
: Why would I guess that you’re the problem when Wakana’s got the downer mindset of Edgar Allan Poe and the medicinal tendencies of Heath Ledger?
: Because I’m the one with less self-confidence than a rabbit being chased by a fox.
: Wakana is many things, but I’m not sure a “fox” is one of them. At least not in the...animal sort of way.
: Please refrain from subtly voicing your attraction to my girlfriend even if we’re in a bit of a tight spot right now.
: It’s not just Wakana. I’d also like to be in a tight spot with you if you know what I’m saying.
: All I know is that I’m suddenly nauseous.
: And also that...this has been in the works for a long time. You’ve known from the start that I’m pretty much always kind of...worried when it comes to my relationship with Wakana.
: And I guess that...has just finally weighed on her a little too much with some of the things I’ve been saying to her.
: So I’ve started working on Osako 2.0 — the new, confident and cool model who will be able to give her partner tons of love and tons of orgasms.
: I see.
: So the time has finally come for the apprentice to teach his master. What you want to do with your hands is-
: I don’t need your help with sexual stuff, Akira! That comes down to...finding the right medication or...something.
: You don’t sound very confident about that, Osako.
: I KNOW! ARE YOU NOT PAYING ATTENTION?! THAT’S LIKE THE ROOT CAUSE OF ALL OF MY PROBLEMS!
: Regaining my confidence is just one step on the way to a new me — one whose existence doesn’t entirely revolve around her partner.
: I’m going to live how I want to live, and Wakana is going to see that I’m not just...some robot who was put here to want to fuck her.
: And if I have to sideline love for a little while in order to do that, fine. She’s made it clear that she’s not going anywhere if I’m going to actively try and change. So that’s what this is.
: So I have her to thank for your cool, new haircut. Got it.
: In a roundabout way, I guess so. But with new hair comes new...other stuff. And from this point on, the Osako Osaka you know is going to be better and more likable.
: Awesome. So what’s the next step now that you’ve cut your hair?
: I have no fucking clue. All I do apart from letting Wakana put stuff inside me is work. I think I need to...find a hobby or something. What do you do for fun, Akira?
: Besides Ayane and Imani and whoever else you subject to your gross man-hands.
: Oh.
: Is there even anything else? Or is that literally all you do?
: I mean...
: I guess there’s porn?
: Your hobby is porn?
: The heart wants what the heart wants, Osako.
: I think you’re confusing your heart with that weird, fleshy growth between your legs.
: Yeah...I do that a lot, actually.
: So, do you have any idea of other things I can do that don’t involve making porn a major part of my life and free time?
: No, not really. Let’s get really into porn together.
: I think I’d rather just break up with Wakana at that point.
: You’ll cave. I know you.
: No, you know the old me. The new me doesn’t do stuff like that.
: Yes she does.
: No she doesn’t.
: Yes she does.
: No...she doesn’t.
: I fucking hate you, Akira.
: Called it. This is great, though. Because now we can start a porn club.
: I already have one! It’s called “Maki Miyamura’s MILF of the Month Membership — where mammaries become memories.”
I meet up with Osako later that night after her shift at the maid cafe.
And while she verbally disapproved of this affair becoming her next hobby (many times), it’s the only thread we have in common and the only way I can see myself helping.
I just hope she doesn’t feel weird about watching porn next to a heterosexual male that she will never want to have sex with as a tried and true lesbian woman.
: You know, as a tried and true lesbian woman, I’ve gotta say — it feels kind of weird watching  porn next to a heterosexual male that I will never want to have sex with.
: Yay! That sentence implies it’s possible you’ll want to have sex with me one day. And while many others might be disturbed by that, I actually find it rather flattering.
: Be careful, Maki. Osako is “kind of” in a relationship right now and you don’t want to step on her toes.
: Kind of? Are you and Watabe-sensei still having trouble? Did the Official Dildo Saber not fix everything? Because it says on the box that it’s supposed to.
: Oh, right. You already know each other because Osako is a freak.
: Some jobs just require certain tools and not all of us have them built into our bodies. But no, we’re fine. Ish. That’s not why I’m here, though.
: So you are going to join the MILF of the Month club?
: I...don’t think so. I’m not really a MILF girl.
: Not yet you’re not. But only because the film we’re watching today hasn’t had a chance to convert you yet.
: Behold! The star of September — Reiko Kobayakawa! At only 41 years of age, she’s already starred in hundreds of films!
: Born in Tokyo and coming in at 165cm, her three sizes are 35/24/35! Making her not just an excellent role model for young women everywhere, but wonderfully proportionate!
: Did you...memorize all of that for the sake of your club? Or...
: No. I memorized it for the sake of my heart.
: I see...
I tear myself away from September’s MILF of the Month and watch Osako as she...watches her. Which is weird. I know. But seeing her in a context like this is...kind of interesting to me.
Like, maybe the two of us really can become porn buddies? And-
: Please stop staring at me while a MILF is being audibly railed right in front of you.
: I’m sorry. I was just thinking of how nice this is.
: Why?
: Well, it’s just that everyone else I know wants to sleep with me. But with you, I can kick back and relax and enjoy my hobbies without having to worry about that.
: Surely it’s not everyone. Like, you’re not banging Maki, are you?
: Not currently. We can. I’d just have to charge you the live performance fee. And also ask you to vacate the couch since the floor is kind of sticky in here.
: He would be if I had anything to do with it. But breaching parent-teacher norms with me seems to be out of the question at this point in time for our friend here.
: Oooookay. Then I guess maybe I might be the only person you can do this with. But that doesn’t mean I want to.
: But you’re here, aren’t you?
: Yeah — but that’s only because I’m trying to find a new hobby, remember?
: Chances are, I’ll be trying out a bunch of new stuff in the near future. And getting this one out of the way early will at least get you off my back for a little while.
: “Trying a bunch of new stuff” you say?
: Are you actually even attracted to me? Or are you just being non-stop flirty today because you know nothing’s going to come of it?
: Probably both. It’s fun being able to test how smooth I am on someone who isn’t going to cave.
: Wow. I’m starting to think you might be more in-need of new interests than me and your relationship isn’t teetering on the edge of destruction right now.
: If you’re looking for a new hobby, how about fishing?
: Fishing?
: This again?
: It’s what my husband used to do when he was looking to clear his head. And based on that “teetering on the edge of destruction” comment, it sounds like that might help.
: Porn is great and all. Like, don’t get me wrong — it’s my favorite thing in the world. But I can see how it wouldn’t be...beneficial during times like this.
: Even if I don’t really grasp what the specific issue is.
: Osako’s trying to be more confident and independent so her entire existence stops revolving around her significant other.
: Oh. Well, maybe fishing’s not the best bet then. Maybe you should become a race car driver.
: You two are pretty terrible at this, aren’t you?
: Hey, we’re not the ones who can’t figure out what to do with our lives.
: You’re absolutely someone who can’t figure out what to do with his life.
: Okay, yeah. But Maki’s not. She was born to sell sex to people. And we were born to buy it.
: Can you please stop lumping me in with you just because I followed you to a porn shop I was probably going to come to this week anyway?
: I can, yeah. But I want you to know that this is how I’m trying to connect with you because I do want you to become more confident in yourself.
: You’re too...strong and loyal to be all miserable like this. And I want your relationship to succeed just as badly as you do.
: Yeah, but you only want it to succeed because you think it increases your chances of having a threesome with us one day and that is very much not the case.
: That’s not true, Osako. Seriously.
: So you’d reject such an invitation if it ever actually happened?
: I mean...no. But it’s not like I have an ulterior motive here.
: I want you to get better because I want you to be happy. And I just think it would be cool if you two could go back to being happy together rather than confused and...distant.
: You...do?
: Obviously, yes. I’ve been trying to tell you that this whole time.
: Sorry, I just...don’t really get why you’re being so nice to me when Wakana’s the one you’re close with. You and I are kinda just, like...there.
: Yeah, but we don’t have to be. We can be closer. I want to be closer.
: Is this about the haircut again? Because you never got like this with me until-
: No. It’s about me being in the same boat as you. Just instead of it being a relationship that’s teetering on the edge, it’s everything about me.
: I’m not happy. And I want to change too. So being around someone who also wants to do that is...
: Wait, where did Maki go?
: Refilling the lotions! It seemed like you two were about to have a moment and I didn’t want to get in the way!
: Well, that’s...nice.
: Akira, I...
: I don’t really know what to say. I’ve never really thought of you on...that level before.
: And I’m not saying you should now. I get that we’re not close, and that it’s hard to just...open up to people you’re not really comfortable with.
: But I know you care about me on some level because of what you said in the diner. And I’m the type of person who can’t help but immediately latch onto any amount of affection from anyone.
: And how you kicked the living shit out of me just before we went there.
: I obviously can’t do that to you, so...I guess this is my equivalent.
: But I’m clearly not good at connecting with people verbally, so...
: No, dude...I appreciate it.
: You’re just so fucking...odd that I can’t normally figure out when and...if you’re being serious.
: You’d think that after dealing with Wakana for so long that I’d be able to get a grasp of that easier, but...I guess it’s a little harder when you don’t also want to screw the person in question.
: That’s fair. I’d probably feel the same way in your position.
: You really want to be closer to me?
: If you’re okay with that, yeah.
: And you’re fine with me not wanting to screw you?
: I am, yeah.
: And you’re not going to try and screw my girlfriend?
: Do you want to just make a checklist for me to go over when I get home later? Because it seems like that might be best right now.
: No...it’s fine.
: Let’s...hang out more. Maybe we can find something to do together that...isn’t sitting around and watching porn.
: Are you sure it can’t be that? Because the MILF of the Month club does sound really fun.
: You know, that Kobayakawa girl really is hot. So if they’re all like this and it’s only once a month...
: You think you’d ever hook up with a girl that age?
: I don’t know. I’ve only been with Wakana before. But, like...isn’t that girl even younger than Rika?
: You think you’d ever hook up with Rika?
: She has a better shot than you do, at least.
: I want to be offended by that, but Rika’s extremely attractive and I understand completely.
: I’m gonna tell her you said that the next time we’re at the bar.
: You don’t have to. I’ll do it myself. Just not while Imani’s around. She gets jealous easily.
: True. You two have sex yet?
: Nah, we’re waiting until the next time all four of us are together.
: Okay. But if you make eye contact with me again while that’s happening, I swear to God that we’re never hanging out again.
: I just wanted to make sure you were doing everything correctly.
: Hey, remember earlier when I said I fucking hate you?
Maki comes back into the room a few minutes later and the three of us finish watching the MILF of the Month have sex with...many different men.
And despite that “film” dragging on for way longer than it had any right to, I think it’s safe to say we all had a good time.
And I think it’s safe to say that I’m on the cusp of having another close friend.
So maybe Osako can be what I wanted Imani to be — someone I can spend time with and just...
That’s it.
That’s all I need sometimes.
We go our separate ways.
But she falls asleep holding someone who sees her, and I fall asleep holding myself.
Osako’s affection has increased to [osako_love]!
